phan.noi_dung:
> **Eating out in Vietnam**
> 
> Street food is an important part of daily life in Vietnamese cities. Most stalls open early in the morning and serve breakfast dishes such as pho or banh mi. A bowl of noodles usually costs between 30,000 and 50,000 dong, which is much cheaper than a restaurant meal. Customers sit on small plastic chairs on the pavement, often very close to the traffic.
> 
> Many stalls sell only one dish, and they have made it for many years. Because they cook the same thing every day, the quality is usually very high. Vegetarians can find it difficult, however, as meat or fish sauce is used in most dishes. Some newer places now offer vegetarian versions, but they are mainly in tourist areas.

**True / False / Not Given (6–8):**
6. Street food stalls usually open early.
7. Most stalls sell many different dishes.
8. Street food is more popular than restaurant food.

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 60–70 từ về một món ăn bạn thích: tên món, nguyên liệu chính, ăn ở đâu, giá bao nhiêu.
writing.bai_mau: My favourite dish is bun bo Hue. It is a spicy noodle soup from central Vietnam. The main ingredients are rice noodles, beef, some lemongrass and a lot of chilli. I usually eat it at a small restaurant near my office. A bowl costs about fifty thousand dong, which is cheap for such a big portion. I have it for breakfast once or twice a week.

cham_diem.tieu_chi: Đếm được / không đếm được đúng (2đ)
cham_diem.vi_sao: Không đếm được: beef, lemongrass, chilli (không thêm s). Đếm được: rice noodles, ingredients. Phân loại đúng hết.
a spicy noodle soup · some lemongrass (không đếm được) · a lot of chilli · a bowl · a small restaurant.
Tên món · nguyên liệu · nơi ăn · giá · tần suất.

dang_hoc: Danh từ không đếm được không bao giờ thêm s và không đi với a/an: some beef, a lot of rice.
Đơn vị đếm cho thứ không đếm được: a bowl of soup, a glass of water, a slice of bread.
“which is cheap for such a big portion” — mệnh đề quan hệ nâng chất lượng câu rõ rệt.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ a rice → ✅ some rice (hoặc a bowl of rice)
❌ many chilli → ✅ a lot of chilli (không đếm được thì không dùng many)

speaking.de_tom_tat: What is your favourite dish? / Do you often eat out or cook at home? / Describe a typical breakfast in your country.

cau_tra_loi.mau: It has to be bun bo Hue. It's a spicy beef noodle soup. I love it because the broth has so much flavour.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “It has to be…” là cách nói tự nhiên khi phải chọn một thứ.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Do you often eat out or cook at home?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I eat out more than I should. During the week I'm too busy to cook, so I usually grab something near the office. At the weekend I cook a bit more.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Câu lựa chọn: chọn rõ → nêu lý do → nói về vế còn lại. Ba bước, luôn đủ dài.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Describe a typical breakfast in your country.
cau_tra_loi.mau: Most people eat something hot — noodle soup, sticky rice or banh mi. We usually buy it from street vendors on the way to work rather than cooking at home.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Câu hỏi về “your country” thì dùng we và most people, không nói về riêng mình.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Đủ, câu 3 nói về cộng đồng đúng yêu cầu đề.
“It has to be…”, “more than I should” giữ mạch.

meo_noi: “grab something” = ăn tạm — cụm khẩu ngữ rất tự nhiên.
Câu hỏi về đất nước mình thì đổi sang “we” và “most people” — đây là lỗi hay bị trừ điểm.
